semanticText:
# Reservation Clause

Maintains reviewed group reservations and cancellation decisions on an Order. `snapshot` defaults to `/orderSnapshot`, `state` to `/reservations`, `requests` to `/reservationRequests` and `timing` to `/cancellationTiming`. Initialization uses the frozen quote, group selections and reservation terms when the snapshot exists. A configured customer role can also pin the Order's customer account to the activation roster.

Groups start awaiting a supplier decision unless automatic confirmation applies. Automatic confirmation requires matching supplier readiness, a future exact start and immediate-charge consent when the cancellation terms require it. Connected actions allow proposal confirmation, alternatives, acceptance and response deadlines. A proposal review references its exact BlueId. Request keys correlate action, input and actor. An identical retry is a duplicate, while key conflicts and stale proposals are rejected. The configured connections supply workflow authority.

A confirmed group has a start and can be fulfilled once that start is reached. Where cancellation terms are present, cancelling, supplier cancellation, no-show, declining or expiry follow their separate state and time guards. Customer cancellation can apply configured timing rules or the group's free-cancellation cutoff. Supplier cancellation records no late charge through this action. No-show applies the configured charge after the confirmed start. Expiry requires a reached response deadline. A terminal decision records the reason, actor, reviewed proposal, time, charge and released amount. These amounts belong to the frozen quote currency. The decision requests payment evidence to establish settlement.
